description.zh: 账号名称，默认（不填任何值）表示查询所有账号。
description.en: The username of the account. If you do not specify this parameter, all accounts of the instance are queried.

description.zh: 实例中的Database，默认（不填任何值）表示查询所有DB，取值为0 ~ 255，示例0表示DB 0。
description.en: The name of the database in the instance. If you do not specify this parameter, all databases are queried. Valid values: 0 to 255. 0 specifies database 0.

description.zh: 查询结束时间，必须晚于查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 > 由于审计日志的条目数较多，一般查询的时间范围建议在10分钟以内，最长不超过1天。
description.en:
The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

> We recommend that you specify a time range of 10 minutes or less because audit logs contain a great number of entries. Do not specify a time range that is longer than one day.

description.zh: 客户端IP，默认（不填任何值）为查询所有地址。
description.en: The IP address of the client. If you do not specify this parameter, this call applies to all clients.

description.zh:
实例中的节点ID。传入本参数可查询指定节点的监控信息。

> * 当实例的架构为读写分离或集群架构时，本参数才可用。
> * 您可以调用[DescribeLogicInstanceTopology](~~473786~~)接口查询节点ID。
description.en:
The ID of the node in the instance. You can set this parameter to query the monitoring data of a specified node.

> 

*   This parameter is available only for read/write splitting and cluster instances.

*   You can call the [DescribeLogicInstanceTopology](~~473786~~) operation to query node IDs.
The number of the page to return.

description.zh: 每页显示的最大记录数。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page.

description.zh:
根据指定的命令查询审计日志，默认查询所有执行过的命令。

> 只能传入单个关键词。
description.en:
The keyword based on which the audit logs are queried. You can specify a command as a keyword to query logs. By default, all commands are queried.

> You can specify only a single keyword in each call.
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

descriptions.zh: 调用本接口时，实例必须已开启审计日志，详情请参见[ModifyAuditLogConfig](~~473829~~)。
descriptions.en: Before you call this operation, you must enable the audit log feature for the instance. For more information, see [ModifyAuditLogConfig](~~473829~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun r-kvstore describe-audit-records --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --node-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000-db-0 --account-name demo --database-name 0 --query-keywords maxclients --host-address 127.0.0.1 --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --start-time 2019-03-24T12:10:00Z --end-time 2019-03-25T12:10:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun r-kvstore DescribeAuditRecords --region cn-hangzhou --QueryKeywords maxclients --PageSize 30 --EndTime '2019-03-25T12:10:00Z' --InstanceId 'r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000' --PageNumber 1 --NodeId 'r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000-db-0' --DatabaseName 0 --StartTime '2019-03-24T12:10:00Z' --HostAddress '127.0.0.1' --AccountName demo
